caption: Figure 3: Architecture comparison between BigStation and Hydra (uplink). Unlike BigStation, Hydra shuffles data only after the subcarrier-parallel stage. “ZF”, ”Equal”, ”Demod”, and “Decode” are short for zero-forcing, equalization, de- modulation, and LDPC decoding, respectively.
